polishes.name: Nebula Chain
polishes.description: A dark indigo jelly base with green-gold shifting aurora shimmer and scattered holo microflakes. This polish was inspired by the fireworks show at Bilbo's 111th birthday party. Note that holographic polishes show their rainbow sparkle best under a source of bright, direct light, such as natural sunlight or a halogen bulb lamp. Swatch photos are taken in direct lighting, with a glossy topcoat, to best show the holo effect. In most holo polishes, there will still be some sparkle in indoor lighting, but the strong holo rainbow effect may be muted or not show up. General Product Info: Warning: For external use only While I try to accurately capture all of my products, variations between screens can cause slight differences in color. Also, because I make my polishes in small batches, slight variations in color may occur. I do not accept returns, however if there’s a problem with your order, please let me know ASAP so I can correct it for you. My polishes are all vegan, cruelty free and 10-free, and handmade in California. All full-size bottles are 15 mL. Each bottle includes 2 stainless steel mixer balls. I try to ship items within a business day or two of receiving the order, however I’m often away from home on weekends and may take a couple extra days to process orders. Please note I am currently unable to ship to Hawaii, Alaska and Puerto Rico, or military bases due to shipping laws regarding nail polish. I am only able to ship to the 48 contiguous United States. To keep up with new releases and product info, follow @pinnaclepolish on Instagram, and share your swatches and creations using #pinnaclepolish
